summary: CAIR Action endorsed Seema Badar for the Dublin Unified School District board in the general phase, and Vote for Peace rated her an Ally on human rights and war-lobby funding criteria. She is owner-confirmed as a member of the pro-Palestine Muslim community. BAMC Action supported her, noting she would bring balance to the school district curriculum.
